title: A Lightweight Multi-View Approach to Short-Term Load Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2602.09220v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time series forecasting is a critical task across domains such as energy, finance, and meteorology, where accurate predictions enable informed decision-making. While transformer-based and large-parameter models have recently achieved state-of-the-art results, their complexity can lead to overfitting and unstable forecasts, especially when older data points become less relevant. In this paper, we propose a lightweight multi-view approach to short-term load forecasting that leverages single-value embeddings and a scaled time-range input to capture temporally relevant features efficiently. We introduce an embedding dropout mechanism to prevent over-reliance on specific features and enhance interpretability. translated_title: 一种用于短期负荷预测的轻量级多视角方法
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测是能源、金融和气象等领域的一项关键任务，准确的预测能够支持明智的决策。尽管基于Transformer和大参数量的模型最近取得了最先进的结果，但其复杂性可能导致过拟合和不稳定的预测，尤其是当较早的数据点变得不那么相关时。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于短期负荷预测的轻量级多视角方法，该方法利用单值嵌入和缩放的时间范围输入来高效地捕获时间相关特征。我们引入了一种嵌入丢弃机制，以防止对特定特征的过度依赖并增强可解释性。我们的方法以显著更少的参数实现了具有竞争力的性能，在包括噪声或稀疏数据场景在内的多个数据集上展示了鲁棒性，并对各组成部分的贡献提供了深入见解。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用单值嵌入、缩放时间范围输入和嵌入丢弃机制的轻量级多视角方法，以显著更少的参数实现了具有竞争力的短期负荷预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight multi-view approach to short-term load forecasting that leverages single-value embeddings, scaled time-range inputs, and an embedding dropout mechanism to achieve competitive performance with significantly fewer parameters.
